sloka: रावणम् सगणम् हत्वा परितोष्य आत्म पौरुषम् ।तथा अस्मि कर्ता नचिराद् यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि ॥४-७-४॥
transliteration: rāvaṇam sagaṇam hatvā paritoṣya ātma pauruṣam ।tathā asmi kartā nacirād yathā prīto bhaviṣyasi ॥4-7-4॥

translations.english: 'With all my capability I will kill Ravana and his clan. Thus I will be able to satisfy you soon with my efforts.
